content:
lina_support: Morning — Brightline reported an autopay failure for invoice INV-120359 at 07:14 UTC. Customer sees their bank 3DS modal, submits OTP, then gets a page that says "Authentication failed" and the payment ends as declined.

rachel_engineer: Can you include the invoice_id, request_id, and env plus any settlement webhook payloads?

lina_support: invoice_id: INV-120359, request_id: rq_5f8b2d, event_id: evt-2026-03-16-22, env: prod, acquirer: bright-eu

sam_payments: Looking at the auth trace: acs_result: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, acquirer_risk_score: 0.88. Later the settlement webhook showed status: declined, reason_code: 51 (insufficient_funds). So we're seeing both a failed 3DS auth and an issuer decline on capture.

tony_ops: That combo can happen if the ACS aborts/marks auth invalid and the capture attempt still hits issuer which returns NSF. We should pause auto-retries for this invoice to avoid multiple declines.

claire_csm: Customer is worried — they have recurring PO-based autopay for ~100 invoices/month. Can we offer a safe temporary path while we investigate?

lina_support: I sent the customer a manual-pay link and asked them to try an alternate card. Also advised not to attempt more than two retries.

rachel_engineer: Triage repro steps for eng:
1) In staging, run auth with routing profile region=eu, acquirer=bright-eu, capture=false using the same tokenized PAN to obtain the ACS redirect.
2) Open ACS in an incognito window and complete OTP to observe the acs_result and acs_transaction_id returned in the auth response.

rachel_engineer: Example CURL (staging, redacted key):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/payments/auth \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY\" \\
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-120359","card":{"pan":"<redacted>","exp":"11/27"},"payment_method":"card","3ds":{"return_url":"https://brightline.example/3ds/return"}}'
```

sam_payments: I opened an acquirer escalation ACQ-4991 requesting the full ACS trace and acquirer reason codes for rq_5f8b2d. Initial ETA 72h.

rachel_engineer: Hypotheses to check:
- 3DS version mismatch (merchant requested 2.2 but ACS only supports 2.1) causing challenge failures
- Browser/iframe issues (SameSite cookie flags, ITP blocking) aborting the challenge
- KV/session cache reuse — we rolled an EU-region cache change overnight that might have returned a stale session id to the ACS iframe

tony_ops: Confirmed retries for INV-120359 are paused and invoice flagged on hold. I'll also add structured logging for acs_transaction_id on post-auth events so we can map easier.

claire_csm: Customer replied: their bank says OTP failed validation and that the auth attempt was declined. They claim funds were available and asked whether we can skip 3DS for a one-off to complete the charge.

rachel_engineer: We cannot bypass mandated 3DS flows for EU autopay without the merchant and acquirer agreeing — and often the acquirer refuses bypass for risk reasons. Short-term options: manual payment, alternative card, or merchant-initiated change to routing that doesn't force 3DS (if allowed).

sam_payments: Acquirer initial reply: they see multiple OTP failures for this PAN and flagged it for review; issuer returned reason 51 on capture. Acquirer asked the cardholder to contact their bank to confirm OTP validation behavior.

lina_support: Next actions: (1) keep invoice on hold and continue customer communications, (2) wait for ACQ-4991 ACS traces and reason codes, (3) add acs_tx_id + acquirer_risk_score to auth event payloads for future triage. I'll update this thread when ACQ-4991 has a response.

opsbot: deploy-bot: staging proxy patch rolled at 2026-03-16T03:50Z, no prod changes.

claire_csm: Thanks all — I'll relay guidance to the merchant and ask them to contact issuing bank. Ping me when the acquirer ticket updates. :thumbsup:
